newsitem.title: POLAND: BWR offers to take over Secesyjny bank.
newsitem.headline: BWR offers to take over Secesyjny bank.

text.p: Poland's Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej SA (BWR) has offered to exchange 25 of its shares for each share of the small Bank Secesyjny SA under a merger scheme, BWR said on Tuesday.
It said in a statement that BWR, which now has 35 percent of Secesyjny, planned to take over all Secesyjny shares. Secesyjny shareholders will vote on the plan on December 10, it added.
BWR and Secesyjny officials were not immediately available for comment.
BWR had earlier said its shareholders would vote on the proposed merger on December 23.
